# Insulation Shop

> Insulation Shop is a comprehensive online retailer specializing in thermal insulation products including mineral wool, glass wool, PIR boards, phenolic boards, and polystyrene systems for residential and commercial building applications.

The site offers a wide range of insulation materials from leading manufacturers like Kingspan, Isover, Rockwool, and Knauf, with detailed product information covering thermal performance, fire resistance, acoustic properties, and installation guidance for various building applications.

## Key Topics

- Mineral Wool
- Rock Wool
- Glass Wool Insulation
- PIR Boards
- Phenolic Insulation
- Expanded Polystyrene (EPS)
- External Wall Insulation (EWI)
- Fire Resistance
- Thermal Insulation
- Plasterboards with Insulation
- Cavity Closers
- Kingspan
- Rockwool
- Isover
- Energy Efficiency

## Glass and Mineral Wool Insulation

- [Insulating Products](https://www.insulationshop.co/insulating_products.html): Main product catalog featuring glass wool, rock wool, mineral wool, and PIR boards
- [Glass and Mineral Wool Insulation](https://www.insulationshop.co/glass_and_mineral_wool_insulation.html): Glass and mineral wool insulation products from Knauf, Isover, Rockwool, Ursa
- [Glass Wool Insulation](https://www.insulationshop.co/glass_and_mineral_wool_insulation/glass_wool_insulation.html): Glass wool insulation products with installation guides and R-value comparisons
- [Rock Wool Insulation](https://www.insulationshop.co/glass_and_mineral_wool_insulation/rock_wool_insulation.html): Rock wool and mineral wool products with fire resistance and acoustic properties
- [Plasterboards with Mineral Wool Insulation](https://www.insulationshop.co/glass_and_mineral_wool_insulation/plasterboards-with-mineral-wool-insulation.html): Mineral wool plasterboards for sound reduction, fire resistance, energy efficiency
- [Mineral Wool Slabs for Insulated Render Systems (EWI)](https://www.insulationshop.co/glass_and_mineral_wool_insulation/external_wall_insulation_rock_wool_external_wall_insulation_slabs.html): Rock wool EWI slabs for external wall insulation systems with fire resistance
- [Fire Barriers](https://www.insulationshop.co/glass_and_mineral_wool_insulation/rock_wool_insulation/fire-barriers.html): Fire barriers using rock wool and mineral wool for fire safety protection
- [Rock Wool Cavity Closers](https://www.insulationshop.co/glass_and_mineral_wool_insulation/rock_wool_insulation/rock-wool-cavity-closers.html): High-density mineral wool cavity closers for fire resistance and thermal insulation

## Rigid Insulation Boards

- [PIR Rigid Insulation Boards](https://www.insulationshop.co/pir_rigid_insulation_boards.html): PIR polyisocyanurate rigid thermal insulation boards for walls and roofs
- [Phenolic Insulation Boards](https://www.insulationshop.co/phenolic_rigid_insulation_boards.html): Phenolic rigid insulation boards from Kingspan and Xtratherm with fire resistance
- [Plasterboards with PIR Insulation](https://www.insulationshop.co/pir_rigid_insulation_boards/plasterboard-with-pir-insulation.html): PIR plasterboards offering space-saving thermal protection and efficiency
- [PIR Insulation for Insulated Render Systems](https://www.insulationshop.co/pir_rigid_insulation_boards/pir-insulation-for-insulated-render-systems.html): PIR boards for ETICS external thermal insulation composite systems
- [Plasterboards with Phenolic Insulation](https://www.insulationshop.co/phenolic_rigid_insulation_boards/plasterboards-with-phenolic-insulation.html): High-performance phenolic plasterboards for thermal efficiency and clean finish
- [Phenolic Boards for Insulated Render](https://www.insulationshop.co/phenolic_rigid_insulation_boards/external_wall_insulation_phenolic_external_boards.html): Kingspan Kooltherm K5 phenolic boards for external wall insulation systems
- [Phenolic Cavity Closers](https://www.insulationshop.co/phenolic_rigid_insulation_boards/phenolic-cavity-closers.html): Kingspan phenolic cavity closers for window and door opening sealing

- [Expanded Polystyrene Insulation EPS](https://www.insulationshop.co/polystyrene_insulation_eps_70_online/eps_expanded_polystyrene_insulation.html): EPS expanded polystyrene in grey graphite and white for thermal insulation
